name: Da Lat wine
summary: Wine made in Da Lat from local grapes and specialty fruit.
origin: Wine made in Da Lat from grapes and local specialty fruit.
history: Vang Đà Lạt put out its first bottle in 1999, described as the first grape wine made by Vietnamese producers, and sold more than 2 million litres from 1999 to 2007 (Diễn đàn Doanh nghiệp, 5 August 2009).
howToEat: Drink it, or carry a bottle home.
where: A Da Lat bottle, from grapes and local fruit.
seoDescription: Wine made in Da Lat from local grapes and specialty fruit.
